description: WP-C7 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) DESTRUCTOR OPTICS (Caladius Grav-tank, passive): +1 AP for its ranged attacks against a unit that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE. Fixture cus11e_c7_shoot (P1 Custodes' Shooting phase). A real token click selects the Caladius; its Iliastus accelerator cannon (printed AP -1) is declared at the Boyz with the phase actions the shooting panel sends and resolved by real clicks on Fast Roll / Complete Shooting. The Boyz' save roll in the dice log is made against AP -2. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players 0 CP; the Boyz' wounds inflated.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_BOYZ_B"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
